summary: tools/localci.py leaves nothing behind: every directory it creates (job worktree, per-job Python venv, S24 private HOME, delivery-owner and Android checkouts) is a marked, locked scratch removed on success, failure, runner error and SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP; a startup purge removes only localci's own marked orphans whose owner is dead and that are older than LOCALCI_STALE_HOURS.
reason: The cloud container held about 400 /tmp/localci-python-* venvs (43 MB each, about 17 GB) plus job worktrees from terminated runs; free space fell under the CI floor and later runs stopped with disk_space_insufficient. Causes: bin_for() created a venv per setup-python step and never removed it (also leaked by test_versioned_python_gets_a_setup_python_environment on every samantha-core run), and SIGTERM killed localci without running the job finally block.

tests.name: tools/test_localci.py LocalCiScratchHygieneTests
tests.evidence: 5 new cases run alone: successful two-job run with setup-python, failed step and runner error, SIGTERM and SIGINT to the CLI process during a running step (exit 128+signal, step stopped, no directory, one worktree), purge keeps unmarked, live-PID, locked, foreign-prefix, symlinked, copied-marker and young directories and removes only the marked dead old one. Already registered in .github/workflows/ci.yml job mobile-ui-plugin (python3 ../tools/test_localci.py).

tests.name: tools/test_localci.py (whole file)
tests.evidence: 61 tests OK, run alone (no full localci run); the count of /tmp/localci-* entries was identical before and after, where the previous version left one venv per file run.

capabilities.reason: Off-phone CI tool only; no app action, setting, route or capability changed.

architecture.reason: Same single CI owner and same job sequence; only the lifetime of its temporary directories changes. No new store, daemon or scheduler.

mcp_owner_parity.reason: CI tool only; MCP execution contracts unchanged.

limitations: SIGKILL cannot be intercepted: such a directory stays marked and is purged by a later run once its lock is free and it is older than LOCALCI_STALE_HOURS (default 6).
Directories left by earlier localci versions carry no marker and are never purged by design; removing them is a human decision.
One venv per job is kept on purpose: a run-wide venv would carry pip installs from one job to the next, unlike fresh GitHub runners.
rollback: Revert this commit; off-phone CI tool only, nothing to redeploy.
